stem.text: An object is moving with an initial velocity of $4.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ to the right. The velocity of the object changes so that its final velocity is $3.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ downwards, as shown.

stem.alt: Grey circle with a horizontal arrow pointing right, labelled initial velocity 4.0 m s-1.
Grey circle with a vertical arrow pointing down, labelled final velocity 3.0 m s-1.

stem.text: Which arrow represents the change in velocity of the object?

A.alt: Arrow drawn diagonally, from upper left to lower right.

B.alt: Arrow drawn diagonally, from upper right to lower left.

C.alt: Arrow drawn diagonally, from lower right to upper left.

D.alt: Arrow drawn diagonally, from lower left to upper right.
